name: DAIR-V2X — Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperative Dataset
description: Pioneering large-scale real-world multi-modality dataset for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative autonomous driving, released by Tsinghua University AIR and Baidu. Covers 38 km of urban roads and 10 km of highways in Beijing equipped with roadside sensing infrastructure. Provides 71,254 spatial-temporally synchronized frames pairing vehicle-side LiDAR and camera data with roadside infrastructure sensors, featuring 3D bounding boxes for cooperative 3D object detection.
